capabilities: Visualize tasks across Year, Month, Week, Day, Task, and Gantt views
Parse Tasks plugin emoji and Dataview inline-field task formats
Reschedule tasks by drag-and-drop on calendar and timeline canvases
Expand recurring tasks as virtual instances across all views
Sync tasks bidirectionally with Feishu via OAuth 2.0
disambiguation: Despite the name, the Gantt view is only one of six views; the plugin's core job is full calendar-based task management.
extras: README warns to back up the vault before enabling Feishu sync, since the sync engine writes directly into Markdown files and is under active development. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Beta builds are available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian renders tasks only as checkbox lists, with no calendar, timeline, or Gantt view for scheduling and rescheduling dated tasks.
